meta.name: screen-reader-testing
meta.description: Test web applications with screen readers including VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS. Use when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging accessibility issues, or ensuring assistive technology support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试网页对读屏软件的兼容性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在测试网站的无障碍支持，需要验证读屏兼容性。
copy.tagline_en: Test web compatibility with screen readers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your web app works with screen readers.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按这份指南带你用读屏软件测试网页:给出 VoiceOver、NVDA、JAWS 等阅读器的快捷键和操作步骤,附测试清单、常见问题的 ARIA 修法、调试脚本和注意事项。
howto.when: 当你要验证读屏兼容性、调试无障碍问题或确保辅助技术支持时用它;测试 ARIA 实现、动态内容播报等场景也适用。

say.text: 用 VoiceOver 帮我查这个页面的模态框焦点管理
say.note: 会按 VoiceOver 步骤和清单逐项检查

say.text: 用 NVDA 测试脚本走一遍这个表单
say.note: 会给出读标签、报错、焦点跳转的检查流程

say.text: 这个按钮读屏念不出用途,给我 ARIA 修法
say.note: 会给出 aria-label 等对应改法

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude walks you through testing web pages with screen readers: shortcuts and steps for VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS and others, plus checklists, ARIA fixes for common issues, debug scripts and testing tips.
howto.when_en: Use it when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging assistive technology issues, or ensuring AT support; also for testing ARIA implementations and dynamic content announcements.

say_en.text: Check this page's modal focus management with VoiceOver
say_en.note: Claude walks through VoiceOver steps and checklist

say_en.text: Run the NVDA test script on this form
say_en.note: Covers labels, errors and focus movement checks

say_en.text: This button doesn't announce its purpose, give me the ARIA fix
say_en.note: Returns the matching aria-label style change
